subject: Booking: Dedicated Capacity demo — throughput & latency review
messages:
From: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@fintechplus.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — Dedicated capacity (pilot sizing)

Hi Priyom,

We signed up for a self-serve account and ran a small pilot but are hitting limits as we scale. We need a short walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated to validate throughput and latency targets before procurement. High-level:
- Target workload: ~800 requests/sec sustained during peak windows; bursts to 1.5k for ~2–3 minutes
- P95 latency target: <= 120 ms for generation (typical prompts ~150 tokens)
- Models: planning to use a 8B/13B open model family; happy to discuss quantization options

Can someone from sales + infra/solutions run a 30–45m demo next week to review capacity sizing and deployment options? Please include any pre-read we can review. I’ve CC’d Ravi (infra) who will join this thread.

Thanks,
Daniel Chen
VP Product, FinTech Plus
Attachments: pilot_metrics_snapshot.csv (stub)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Chen <daniel.chen@fintechplus.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Dedicated capacity (pilot sizing)

Hi Daniel — thanks for the details and for signing up. Great to hear the pilot got you this far. I can run the initial sync and I’ll bring Laura (solutions) for capacity planning. A couple quick asks so we can size the session properly:
- Do you expect steady-state 800 r/s across the day or concentrated peaks?
- Any hard latency SLA beyond the P95 number (e.g., 99th pct)?
- Expected concurrency / number of simultaneous users/requestors?

Proposed slots (30–45 mins):
- Tue Aug 11, 10:30–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 12, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu Aug 13, 13:00–13:45 PT

If none work, here’s our short booking link with more slots: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/prioritized-demo-30m

I’m attaching our Dedicated capacity SLA and a short sample throughput report so you and Ravi can look before the demo.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
Attachments: capacity_sla.pdf (stub), sample_throughput_report.xlsx (stub)

Thanks, Priyom. Wed Aug 12 at 09:00 PT looks good for us but can we move it 30 mins later to give Ravi a bit more runway?
Also please include an agenda focused on: throughput profiling, latency SLOs (p95/p99), warm-up/kv-cache strategies, and expected cost per 1M tokens at the target throughput.

Ravi will be our infra lead and needs to see how the Dedicated pool maps to our VPC/networking constraints. We’ll also want to walk through quantization trade-offs for the 13B variant.

Confirming: Wed Aug 12, 09:30–10:15 PT works for both of us.

—Daniel

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Daniel. Confirmed: Wed, Aug 12, 09:30–10:15 PT (45m). I’ve sent a calendar invite (stub) to everyone on thread. Agenda below — please let me know if anything should be added:

Agenda (45m):
- 5m: Introductions & objectives (we’ll align on business outcomes)
- 15m: Dedicated capacity overview + example topologies (single-tenant pool, burst capacity)
- 15m: Throughput & latency deep-dive using your pilot numbers (target: 800 r/s sustained, 1.5k bursts). We’ll show expected p50/p95/p99 and warm-up behavior.
- 5m: Security/networking notes for Private/Dedicated (VPC peering, KMS, audit logs)
- 5m: Next steps / procurement checklist / trial sizing

Pre-reads: capacity_sla.pdf, sample_throughput_report.xlsx (attached). Please complete this quick sizing form before the meeting if possible: https://redwood.ai/sizing-form?deal=FP-2026-089

Attendees from Redwood: Laura Bennett (Solutions Engineer) — will present sizing, Stephanie Nguyen (Product Infra) — available for deep infra/networking Qs.

If anything changes, reply-all and I’ll reschedule. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
